activeSlice.scope: Make ephemeral public Hunter shadow Brand bootstrap deterministic and source-backed so benchmark model quota is reserved for the real V1/V2 comparison lanes. Preserve sanitized live public references, canonical Hunter readiness, provenance, substantive V1 comparability, all rollout thresholds, and Hunter V1 production authority.
successCriteria: Default ephemeral public Brand bootstrap makes zero model-runtime invocations.
Every required Brand Brain group is derived from sanitized live public reference text and bound to the exact supporting source ID.
Policy/boundary context is bound to a policy-like public reference when available.
Canonical Brand Brain activation must be Hunter-ready before an ephemeral Brand enters the cohort.
Custom proposal-generator injection remains available for negative readiness tests and explicit experiments.
The actual V1 and V2 comparison lanes retain their real model calls and measured cost/latency.
Three distinct Brands and nine paired observations remain mandatory for the pre-gate.
All rollout thresholds remain unchanged, including latency 1.5x, cost 1.5x, retrieval 0.85, failure 0.05, exploration 0.08-0.20, and maximum topic share 0.34.
Hunter V1 remains production authority; no V2 persistence, canary, scheduler or production enablement.
Corrected 3x3 pre-gate passes before any 30-pair full gate.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before merge/deployment.

priorPreGateEvidence.reason: Disposable V1 control became comparable, but ephemeral Vercel/GitHub Brand Brain bootstrap still consumed model quota and both exhausted provider retries with HTTP 429 before the paired cohort could be assembled.
